name: crix
description: Crix: streaming coding-agent harness for terminal. OpenAI ChatGPT OAuth + Ollama Cloud 3-slot parallel.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/core packages/tools packages/agent packages/operator packages/cli
scripts.check: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/core packages/tools packages/agent packages/operator packages/cli --pretty false
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'); for (const d of fs.readdirSync('packages')) { const dir=p.join('packages',d); fs.rmSync(p.join(dir,'dist'),{recursive:true,force:true}); for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) if (f.endsWith('.tsbuildinfo')) fs.rmSync(p.join(dir,f),{force:true}); }"
